name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against the long side of a bench, the bottom of your shoulder blades at the edge of the pad.
Put one foot flat on the floor near your hips, with the shin vertical at the top. Lift the other foot and keep that knee bent.
Tuck your chin and brace your trunk.
Push through the heel of the working foot and lift your hips until your trunk and thigh are in a straight line. Squeeze the glute at the top.
Keep your hips level. Do not let the free side drop or rotate.
Lower your hips under control, then repeat. Do all the repetitions on one side, then change sides.
